name: univer
description: The Office Harness for AI Agents — Spreadsheets, Docs, Slides, Canvas, Relational Tables, and PDF in one runtime.
one_liner: A software kit that lets any company bolt a full spreadsheet-and-document editor — like a mini Excel and Google Docs — directly into their own product.
buyer: A SaaS founder building an internal-tools or BI platform who needs spreadsheet editing inside their app (budgets, data grids, reports) but doesn't want to license Google Sheets or build a grid engine from scratch.
business_use_cases: A vertical SaaS for restaurant inventory embeds a live spreadsheet view so owners can edit stock counts the way they already know how to use Excel.
An internal-tools platform for finance teams embeds document and slide editing so budget memos and board decks stay inside the company's own product.
An AI agent platform uses the headless Node.js mode to let an agent read and edit a user's spreadsheet server-side without opening a browser.

money_ideas.idea: Build a niche vertical product on top of it (e.g. spreadsheet-based inventory management for small retailers) and charge monthly.
Offer integration consulting for companies that want spreadsheet/doc editing embedded but lack the engineering time to wire it up.

steal_this: Wire up the headless Node.js mode this weekend to build a 'chat with your spreadsheet' AI agent demo — a genuinely sellable feature for any BI tool.
